description: 大模型文档翻译工具，支持 Excel 翻译、Word 翻译、PDF 翻译和 CAD 图纸翻译（DWG/DXF），双语对照输出，带翻译记忆库，适用于 macOS 和 Windows。AI document translator for Excel, Word, PDF and CAD drawings (DWG/DXF): translate files with any LLM (OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, Qwen, Ollama), with bilingual output and translation memory. Desktop app for macOS and Windows.
pre_install: if ($__app7z) { Expand-7zipArchive $__app7z.FullName "$dir"; Remove-Item "$dir\_extract" -Recurse -Force } else { Move-Item "$dir\_extract\*" "$dir" -Force; Remove-Item "$dir\_extract" -Recurse -Force }
